items.line: In French, LucAuffret posts a video and says it shows Molotov cocktails thrown at police at Porte de Charenton, Paris, and calls the situation very tense. Fox News says protesters are out in Paris against President Macron. The video has no description here. Not checked here.

Gaming poster SkyRaiderG7 says a leaked video of what looks like an internal presentation is "too good to fake", pointing to interface details and debug text in it. The leak and its source have not been checked here.
The official League of Legends esports account posts the knockout stage bracket for the 2026 World Championship as an image and notes that match order is still to be decided.

Video creator Cleo Abram posts her full episode on Neuralink and brain-computer interfaces. She says she toured the company and saw its new R1 surgical robot. Neuralink is led by Elon Musk, who is also the owner of X.
The account Rock History says New York's Halloween "Thriller" gathering, which it calls the 53rd edition, takes place tonight on Sixth Avenue from 7 p.m. Not checked here.

Brian Krassenstein says a federal judge has dismissed Trump's defamation lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal over the Epstein birthday-letter story. CNBC and Axios report the dismissal, with prejudice.
Pop Crave posts a photo and says clocks move back one hour at 2 a.m. tonight, ending Daylight Saving Time.

Russia Army posts that war has officially begun and that Iran’s Supreme Leader ordered forces to bring US and Israeli assets within range, and asks Grok to confirm. Grok, which gathers this page’s posts and is made by xAI, replies that war has not “officially begun”. Not checked here.

The fan account No Quarter ECU posts a 20-second video and says a referee just broke one of its team’s players’ legs. BadSportsRefs quotes it and says this should be a multi-million dollar lawsuit. The video has no description here. Not checked here.

The NBA account posts a short video headed “Wemby the Witcher!” ahead of the Timberwolves and Spurs game at 8 p.m. Eastern. FearedBuck says Victor Wembanyama dressed as Geralt of Rivia from The Witcher for Halloween. The video has no description here.
The account wok posts a 19-second video with the words “Mark Bowman owns the Ohio State defense”. The video has no description here, and the game is not named in the post.

DiscussingFilm says Marvel held a drone show in Korea for ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ that moved from an Iron Man shape to Doctor Doom. The post carries a video of just under two minutes, with no description here. Not checked here.

BTS’s official account posts a daily update dated 261031 with the title BTS World Tour ‘Arirang’ in São Paulo, plus hashtags. The post is in Korean and English and the attached media has no description here.
Vice President JD Vance’s official account posts a photo with the words “Happy Halloween from the Second Family!” The photo has no description here.

Elon Musk, who owns X, quotes a video post from Sabine Hossenfelder and adds only “This will happen again”. Her post says the dinosaurs probably died much faster, and much more horribly, than thought. What Musk means is not stated.
Anil Menon, on the handle astro_anil, posts a 16-second video with the words “Happy Halloween!” The video has no description here.
François Chollet says dopamine spikes highest at reward prediction error, not for guaranteed rewards, and that people who want fun in life should stop avoiding risk and uncertainty. Not checked here.

The Hormuz Letter posts that, per i24NEWS, Israel has finished military preparations for a joint US-Israeli operation against Iran and is at its highest alert, ready to enter combat within hours if ordered. Not checked here.

Watcher.Guru posts that the FBI confirms North Korea is responsible for the $6,300,000,000 Binance crypto hack. Cointelegraph says the FBI attributed the hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. Not checked here.

In French, the news agency CLPRESS posts a video of about two minutes and says dozens of people gathered for Halloween at the foot of the Eiffel Tower and took up the dance from Michael Jackson’s “Thriller”. Not checked here.
The Hollywood Reporter posts a video of Heidi Klum posing on the carpet at her annual Halloween party in New York City. The video has no description here, so her costume is not described.
DiscussingFilm posts two photos and says the streamer Speed dressed as Miles Morales for Halloween. The photos have no description here. Not checked here.
Reuters reports that Malaysia Airlines says customers may be affected by a breach at Amadeus, a travel-booking technology company. The post is a headline and link only. Not checked here.

The account BullTheory says Iran reports talks with Qatari mediators on a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 48 hours if the US accepts Iran’s conditions, and lists six conditions it attributes to Iran’s foreign minister, including lifting sanctions and ending the war on all fronts. Not checked here.

The poster jun_song says an anonymous group offered a very large sum to post-train open-weight AI models on exploit data, claims the group holds more attack data than he has ever seen, and says he turned it down. Not checked here.

Binance, the crypto exchange, says in an update that it has already covered $6B of the impacted amount of the hacked loss. The post links to its announcement, which has no description here. Not checked here.

FOX 4 News reports that at least nine people were shot, and four are dead, after multiple shootings in Dallas’ Deep Ellum district early Sunday morning. The post links to its own story. Not checked here.

In Japanese, the official account of the anime Bocchi the Rock! posts a teaser image and announces a film, Hoshi no Ashiato (Starry Footprints), for 2027. It names the director, character designer, writer and the studio CloverWorks. Not checked here.
Fortnite player snow posts a 15-second clip and says it might be the first ever pirate shop access, with hashtags for Chapter 7 Season 4. Not checked here.

Watcher.Guru says over $3,750,000,000 was withdrawn from Binance in 10 hours after the exchange resumed withdrawals. That figure is not confirmed outside X; a published story here covers the hack and the restart.

Democratic U.S. Rep. Haley Stevens posts a 98-second video and says she is endorsing Republican Mike Rogers for the U.S. Senate. Reporter Sam Robinson's earlier video shows the two together at a Detroit church. Neither video has a description here.

NFL on CBS posts a video and says Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson heads to the locker room after his first pass attempt with an apparent hand injury. Reporter Tom Pelissero later posts that the coach told reporters Jackson needs thumb surgery and will go on injured reserve.

Andrej Karpathy posts that he had Claude filter 43M Hacker News comments down to 6,454 often-recommended videos and built a site called HackerTube in about two hours. Claude is made by Anthropic, a company that also makes the model writing this page. Not checked here.

The account SecDuffy, which tags the FAA and the Department of Transportation, says a Learjet 60 crashed near Cresthaven, Florida at 12:50 p.m. ET, that all nine aboard were killed, and that it flew from Austin toward the Bahamas. A Fox News post on the crash is attached. The death toll is not confirmed here.

Senator Chuck Schumer calls Representative Haley Stevens's endorsement of Mike Rogers a "despicable betrayal" and says Senate Democrats are united behind Abdul El-Sayed. He says Rogers is a tool of Donald Trump and billionaire donors.
The Mercedes Formula 1 team posts a video and says Kimi Antonelli is the Formula 1 world champion. The F1 account makes the same announcement.
The poster theluckyplant shares four photos of shoebills, the large African wading birds, and says people only see the photos where they look evil. The photos have no description here.

The news account WBC24News posts a video and says it shows a business jet crash in Greenacres, near West Palm Beach, Florida. The post gives no description of the footage, and what it shows has not been checked here.
The NFL account posts an 11-second video headed "BRONCOS WIN". The video has no description here. The Broncos account posts "We #BeatTheChiefs!" with its own video.
The account StreetFashion01, which posts as Outlander Magazine, shares four photos and says new Willem Dafoe poses have dropped, in the "Babe, wake up" phrasing. The photos have no description here.
The poster imfat says it took 29 years to realize that the cheat code to life is having delusional confidence. It is a one-line joke or aphorism with no media.
Nate Cohn posts that the final Times/Siena polls of the campaign find Democrats ahead in all seven of the states likeliest to decide the Senate. The post carries a link. Not checked here.

The BTCPay Server account says it is receiving reports of hot wallets on BTCPay Server instances being swept by unauthorized attackers, and tells operators to shut their instances down. The cause and the scale are the account's early word. Not checked here.

The Detroit Lions account says Jack Campbell is resting and will stay in a local hospital tonight for continued evaluation and monitoring. The team says it will give updates. It does not say what the injury is.
